name: tempmovers-platform
_vasrue_note_prisma_seed: BLOCK-11 - VASRUE Digital Media, 24 Oct 2026. prisma/seed.ts existed but package.json declared no prisma.seed command, so `prisma db seed` exited 0 without running anything: no output, no rows written, while running prisma/seed.ts directly seeded correctly. Anyone following the project runbook would have believed the database was seeded when it was not, which is how the eight missing brokerage feature flags went unnoticed. Prisma warns this key is deprecated in favour of prisma.config.ts. NOT migrated deliberately: a Prisma config file does not auto-load .env, which would break DATABASE_URL resolution on the migrate path already verified against a live database. Revisit only when upgrading to Prisma 7, and move env loading at the same time.
_vasrue_note_node_version: BLOCK-13 - VASRUE Digital Media, 25 Oct 2026. engines.node was 22.x, which nothing honoured. Verified by deploying to Vercel: the build ran on Node 24.x, and both Vercel projects (tempmovers and tempmovers-build-verify) are set to 24.x, so 24.x is the actual deployment runtime. A pin that the platform ignores is worse than no pin because it manufactures false confidence about what the code was tested on. Set to 24.x to match the environment the build is actually verified green in. If this is ever moved back, change the Vercel project's Node.js Version setting too - that setting wins over this field, not the other way round.
